English

Generated Narrative: ActorDefinition OrderServer

Actor: OrderServer Order ServerType: system

Answers the unit's searches for tagged MedicationRequests and for requested Tasks, including _include=Task:focus. Accepts the MedicationDispense the unit creates and the updates it makes to the Task or MedicationRequest.

See What Spenser asks of an order server.

name: OrderServer
title: Order Server
description: A FHIR server that holds orders until a Spenser Unit collects them, and receives what the unit reports back.

extension.valueString: Um servidor FHIR que guarda as prescrições até uma Unidade Spenser as recolher, e recebe o que a unidade comunica de volta.
Een FHIR-server die orders bewaart tot een Spenser-unit ze ophaalt, en ontvangt wat de unit terugmeldt.
Un serveur FHIR qui conserve les ordonnances jusqu'à ce qu'une unité Spenser vienne les chercher, et reçoit les comptes rendus de l'unité.

documentation:
Answers the unit's searches for tagged MedicationRequests and for requested Tasks, including `_include=Task:focus`. Accepts the MedicationDispense the unit creates and the updates it makes to the Task or MedicationRequest.

See [What Spenser asks of an order server](interfaces.html#what-spenser-asks-of-an-order-server).
